notes: Word list en/zh taken verbatim from the book's appendix 'Words and expressions' (Unit 2 is on book p62 / PDF p68).
Bold = 义务教育英语课程标准二级词汇. By measured stroke width, all Unit 2 words are bold except 'balloon' and 'number'.
Numbers taught are only one–seven (no eight/nine/ten in this unit).
Sentence/dialogue Chinese translations are NOT printed in the book – they are translations for the game.
'page' = printed book page; 'pdf_page' = PDF page index (book +4 for pp.1-61).
Emoji hints and picture_description are card-illustration suggestions based on the book's pictures.
